evaluation.summary: Deterministic synthetic files; near-only metrics exclude exact positives. See evaluation.md for false positives and false negatives.

browser.scope: Only the explicitly observed browser actions and Node validations below are passed. Browser download contents and mobile layouts are not certified.
browser.browser: Google Chrome via CUA, native file chooser fallback

report.inputProvenance: 59 controlled synthetic benchmark image files, actual MoonBit/CLI output

checks.name: default-report-and-thumbnails
checks.steps: Navigate to local server; observe exact auditId, 59 images / 96 pairs and two rendered thumbnails.

checks.name: candidate-and-path-filter
checks.steps: Select perceptual-candidate and search flat-. Observed 1 / 96 pair, test/flat-blue.png vs train/flat-red.png, dHash distance 0.

checks.name: review-save-and-reload
checks.steps: Mark flat-color synthetic negative as rejected, enter QA note, reload page and search flat-. The selected rejection and exact note reappeared; notice restored one record.

checks.name: review-json-import
checks.steps: Click visible import-review label; native macOS chooser selected demo/qa/review-import-test.json. UI reported one validated merged record. Reload later restored two total records.

checks.name: external-report-image-isolation
checks.steps: Import demo/qa/external-report-test.json through native file chooser. Both image src attributes became null; UI warned that the auditId differs and thumbnails are disabled.

checks.name: nonempty-errors-override-complete
checks.steps: Same test fixture deliberately claims complete=true/status=complete but has one QA_INJECTED_ERROR. UI displayed incomplete status and prominent coverage warning.

checks.name: export-buttons
checks.steps: Clicked Export review and Export full report controls. Chrome native UI later showed review.json 516 B completed. No download event waiter was used in final run; file contents and second file completion were not inspected.

checks.name: restore-served-report
checks.steps: Click reload report. Original served auditId and thumbnails returned, both imported and manually entered QA marks restored.

checks.name: browser-console
checks.steps: Chrome tab dev.logs warn/error query returned an empty array after final actions.

notTested.name: browser-downloaded-json-content
notTested.reason: The IAB download event tooling stalled and was interrupted. Final Chrome run verifies button clicks and review.json completed indicator only; no claim of downloaded file byte validation.

notTested.name: browser-complete-report-download
notTested.reason: Control clicked, final download completion and bytes not inspected.

notTested.name: mobile-viewport
notTested.reason: Responsive CSS exists but final real-device/mobile viewport testing was outside the bounded verification.

notTested.name: missing-default-report-empty-state
notTested.reason: Code implements explicit empty state but final server always supplied a valid report.

screenshots.description: Actual final source, synthetic flat-color candidate rejected with a persisted QA note.
Deliberately modified QA fixture: different auditId and injected error; no thumbnails and prominent incomplete warning.

notes: All manual marks in these browser sessions are labeled QA observations on controlled synthetic fixtures, not a human audit of a real dataset.
External-report fixture intentionally modifies auditId and errors and is not an authentic CLI output.
File chooser event failed for the visually hidden file input; clicking its visible label and using the native chooser succeeded without changing browser permissions.
